title: Churn Risk Over Time (Synthetic Lumen)
description: Fixed-model next-renewal risk on synthetic Lumen records. Source and model version are explicit. Revenue at risk is illustrative probability times next-renewal price, never saved revenue.

list.name: app
list.label: App
list.query: SELECT DISTINCT app_id FROM churn_risk_current WHERE prediction_source = '$source' ORDER BY 1
list.definition: SELECT DISTINCT app_id FROM churn_risk_current WHERE prediction_source = '$source' ORDER BY 1

list.name: model
list.label: Model
list.query: SELECT DISTINCT model_id FROM churn_risk_current WHERE app_id = '$app' AND prediction_source = '$source' ORDER BY 1
list.definition: SELECT DISTINCT model_id FROM churn_risk_current WHERE app_id = '$app' AND prediction_source = '$source' ORDER BY 1

list.name: version
list.label: Model version
list.query: SELECT DISTINCT model_version FROM churn_risk_current WHERE app_id = '$app' AND model_id = '$model' AND prediction_source = '$source' ORDER BY 1
list.definition: SELECT DISTINCT model_version FROM churn_risk_current WHERE app_id = '$app' AND model_id = '$model' AND prediction_source = '$source' ORDER BY 1

list.name: user
list.label: Subscriber token (synthetic)
list.query: SELECT md5(user_id) FROM churn_risk_current WHERE app_id = '$app' AND model_id = '$model' AND model_version = '$version' AND prediction_source = '$source' ORDER BY churn_probability DESC LIMIT 200
list.definition: SELECT md5(user_id) FROM churn_risk_current WHERE app_id = '$app' AND model_id = '$model' AND model_version = '$version' AND prediction_source = '$source' ORDER BY churn_probability DESC LIMIT 200

panels.title: Current churn probability (mean of latest per subscriber)

targets.rawSql: SELECT AVG(churn_probability) AS "Mean current churn probability", COUNT(*) AS "Subscribers" FROM churn_risk_current WHERE app_id = '$app' AND model_id = '$model' AND model_version = '$version' AND prediction_source = '$source'

panels.title: Expected next-renewal revenue at risk (not saved revenue)

targets.rawSql: SELECT SUM(expected_revenue_at_risk_usd) AS "Revenue at risk ($)" FROM churn_risk_current WHERE app_id = '$app' AND model_id = '$model' AND model_version = '$version' AND prediction_source = '$source'

panels.title: Current churn probability by subscriber (latest prediction)

targets.rawSql: SELECT md5(user_id) AS "Subscriber token", effective_at AS "As of", churn_probability AS "Churn probability", churn_probability_change AS "Change since previous", renewal_due_at AS "Renewal due", expected_revenue_at_risk_usd AS "Revenue at risk ($)" FROM churn_risk_current WHERE app_id = '$app' AND model_id = '$model' AND model_version = '$version' AND prediction_source = '$source' ORDER BY expected_revenue_at_risk_usd DESC NULLS LAST, churn_probability DESC LIMIT 50

SELECT effective_at AS "time", md5(user_id) AS metric, churn_probability AS value FROM churn_risk_trajectory WHERE app_id = '$app' AND model_id = '$model' AND model_version = '$version' AND prediction_source = '$source' AND md5(user_id) IN (${user:sqlstring}) AND $__timeFilter(effective_at) ORDER BY 1

panels.title: Change in churn risk since the previous prediction (selected subscribers)

targets.rawSql: SELECT effective_at AS "time", md5(user_id) AS metric, churn_probability_change AS value FROM churn_risk_trajectory WHERE app_id = '$app' AND model_id = '$model' AND model_version = '$version' AND prediction_source = '$source' AND md5(user_id) IN (${user:sqlstring}) AND churn_probability_change IS NOT NULL AND $__timeFilter(effective_at) ORDER BY 1

SELECT date_trunc('day', effective_at) AS "time", AVG(churn_probability) AS "Mean churn probability", SUM(expected_revenue_at_risk_usd) / NULLIF(COUNT(DISTINCT date_trunc('day', effective_at)), 0) AS "Revenue at risk ($)" FROM churn_risk_trajectory WHERE app_id = '$app' AND model_id = '$model' AND model_version = '$version' AND prediction_source = '$source' AND $__timeFilter(effective_at) GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

panels.title: Largest risk changes in the selected time range
panels.description: Largest signed changes in stored churn probability, ordered by magnitude. Negative values mean lower predicted risk; synthetic predictions do not establish model accuracy or treatment effect.

targets.rawSql: SELECT md5(user_id) AS "Subscriber token", effective_at AS "As of", previous_churn_probability AS "Previous", churn_probability AS "Now", churn_probability_change AS "Change", expected_revenue_at_risk_usd AS "Revenue at risk ($)" FROM churn_risk_trajectory WHERE app_id = '$app' AND model_id = '$model' AND model_version = '$version' AND prediction_source = '$source' AND churn_probability_change IS NOT NULL AND $__timeFilter(effective_at) ORDER BY ABS(churn_probability_change) DESC LIMIT 25

panels.title: Simulated A/B lineage events (no measured effect)
panels.description: Counts of explicitly simulated assignment, actual exposure and mature outcome records. A missing event is absent, not zero uplift.

targets.rawSql: SELECT variation_id AS "Simulated variation", kind AS "Event kind", COUNT(*)::integer AS "Events" FROM experiment_lineage WHERE app_id = '$app' AND model_id = '$model' AND model_version = '$version' AND source = 'simulated' AND '$source' = 'external' AND $__timeFilter(event_at) GROUP BY variation_id, kind ORDER BY variation_id, kind

panels.title: Simulated assignment to exposure to outcome (pending remains pending)
panels.description: One row per simulated assignment. Exposure and mature outcome are shown only when their own records exist. No customer identifiers or causal uplift.

targets.rawSql: SELECT a.experiment_id AS "Experiment", a.variation_id AS "Simulated variation", a.event_at AS "Assigned at UTC", e.event_at AS "Exposed at UTC", o.event_at AS "Mature outcome at UTC", CASE WHEN o.event_at IS NOT NULL THEN 'mature' WHEN e.event_at IS NOT NULL THEN 'outcome pending' ELSE 'exposure pending' END AS "Lineage state" FROM experiment_lineage a LEFT JOIN experiment_lineage e ON e.kind = 'actual-exposure' AND e.app_id = a.app_id AND e.experiment_id = a.experiment_id AND e.assignment_id = a.assignment_id AND e.source = 'simulated' LEFT JOIN experiment_lineage o ON o.kind = 'next-renewal-outcome' AND o.app_id = a.app_id AND o.experiment_id = a.experiment_id AND o.assignment_id = a.assignment_id AND o.exposure_id = e.exposure_id AND o.source = 'simulated' WHERE a.kind = 'actual-assignment' AND a.source = 'simulated' AND a.app_id = '$app' AND a.model_id = '$model' AND a.model_version = '$version' AND '$source' = 'external' AND $__timeFilter(a.event_at) ORDER BY a.event_at DESC LIMIT 50
